newsitem.title: USA: China Yuchai sees no improvement in 2H96.
newsitem.headline: China Yuchai sees no improvement in 2H96.

text.p: China Yuchai International Ltd said on Thursday it did not expect its financial performance to improve in the second half of 1996, given truck industry fundamentals and the tight credit environment.
Second half results could be worse than its first half results if these factors did not improve, the company said.

The company said its net sales for the six months ended June 30 fell 33.9 percent from the same period last year to 640.8 million yuan. The number of diesel engines sold fell to 28,092 in the first half, from 41,294 in the first half last year, it said.

Weak results were due to further downturn in the medium- duty diesel engine truck industry, the Chinese government's continued tight credit policy, increased competition and financial troubles at a large customer, the company said.
Large customers were also being protectionist, which hurt sales, China Yuchai said.
The company said it continued to keep tight control over expenses and capital spending, and it had increased its marketing efforts.
There were also encouraging signs that additional credit facilities were being made available to large state companies, it said. This could lead to increased sales, China Yuchai said.
